usage: Open only 2-4 exemplars that match the current design problem. Learn the relationship and degree of hierarchy; never copy exact geometry, copy, palette, typeface, or assets.

exemplars.learn: One dominant statement, subordinate proof, structural negative space.
Real product evidence leads; supporting copy and controls stay subordinate.
One media system and one focal motion idea carry the page.
Clear role contrast beats adding more containers or decoration.
Repeated equal cards flatten hierarchy and make every section feel interchangeable.
AI-coded visual clichés can create polish without product specificity.
